affordance_in_statement: For a channel connecting node u and node v, we construct a characteristic state matrix: M_{u,v} = ((x_u, 1), (-1, x_v)). The channel's resonance is defined as the determinant of this matrix. The network's overall resonance is defined as the product of the resonances of all m channels. ... perfectly balanced if and only if its overall resonance is exactly 3^m.
removal_suggestion: There is no semantics-preserving wording change that removes this shortcut: the determinant is x_u x_v + 1, whose possible values are 2, 3, and 5, so the positive product can equal 3^m only when every edge has endpoints 1 and 2. Removing the shortcut would require changing the determinant/product condition itself, not merely re-presenting it.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Reduces the condition to bipartite coloring and processes each connected component with BFS.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: The determinant/product condition forces every channel to join differently assigned tiers.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Builds an undirected adjacency list and uses bipartite coloring, with an explicit all-1 assignment for m = 0.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: The channels are bidirectional and the required edge condition is exactly a 1-versus-2 constraint.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Starts every component with tier 1 and alternates tiers using color[v] = 3 - color[u].
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: The lexicographically smallest valid coloring is obtained by orienting each component from its first, smallest-index vertex.

common_affordance: The positive product of determinants equaling 3^m forces every edge determinant to equal 3, which is equivalent to requiring x_u and x_v to be different on every edge, i.e. bipartite graph coloring.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: The submitted implementation received TLE. The visible excerpt is an apparently linear-time adjacency-list traversal, so no definite logical reasoning error is identifiable from the excerpt; the failure appears to be implementation/runtime related.

recommended_edit: No effective edit exists without changing the core mathematical task. Any genuine attempt to defeat all survivors must alter the determinant/product resonance condition so that non-3 edge factors can participate in the global target; merely rewording the current condition will not remove the intrinsic bipartite reduction.
